evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Manage and prioritize multiple concurrent analytics projects and tasks efficiently.

evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Integrate analytics data with marketing platforms such as Google Ads and major Social Media platforms.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role centers on marketing/digital analytics tracking (Google Ads, social media platforms, website performance), a commercial/marketing orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: Implement tracking requirements using JavaScript and Front-End development concepts.

evidence.testing_framing: Absent — no testing, data quality, or data contract language appears anywhere in the JD.

evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Utilize behaviour analytics and data-driven insights to tangibly improve website performance.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role improves and extends existing tracking/analytics setups (tag management, marketing platform integration) rather than building new infrastructure from scratch, indicating fix/scale.
